title: rubus affinis subsp. rogersii
intro: Rubus affinis subsp. rogersii, commonly known as Rogers' bramble or Rogers' blackberry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rubus affinis subsp. rogersii include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
